expectation: Membrane ring on a subset of T helper cells (plus dimmer monocytes/macrophages), scattered in lamina propria and clustered in lymphoid aggregates, largely absent from epithelium; roughly 10-30% of cells.
observed: A: yellow speckle concentrated in the lamina propria core of villi and denser in the central lymphoid-rich region, sparse in epithelium. B/C: mostly empty with a few saturated blobs. D: a few bright blobs. E1: clear ring-like membrane staining on a dense cell subset, matching CD3E-high cells in E3 (white), with blobs as green-only artefacts.
why: CD4 shows membrane rings on a cell subset in the lamina propria and lymphoid zone that overlaps CD3E-positive cells, despite a few bright artefact blobs.
